validation_rules: Rate-based entitlement is tested against the disclosed eligible calculation base for feasible candidates.
Infeasible candidates may pay less than contractual entitlement only when the run discloses mandatory-payment shortfall or equivalent failed constraints.
Landowner value is nondecreasing as the contractual rate increases.
Developer NPV is nonincreasing as the contractual rate increases.
Every candidate must calculate successfully and reconcile monthly cash.
Fair Floor, Balanced, Policy-Adjusted Ceiling, Residual Equivalent, Current Offer and Technical Ceiling remain distinct comparison points.
Policy selection changes policy-adjusted recommendations while preserving underlying technical project economics.
